notes: f64 arithmetic in the spec's exact order: V emits the expressions to C as written, and -ffp-contract=off stops gcc from fusing a * b + c into an FMA (no -march flag, so the x86-64 baseline has none anyway).
Each row is packed into a reused []u8 (8 pixels per byte, MSB first) and appended to a 64 KiB strings.Builder written to os.stdout() per chunk.
v -prod (gcc -O3 -flto), statically linked against musl and stripped, running on a scratch image.
